annotations.title: Make micro-drama, short film or trailer

description: Make a micro-drama episode (30 seconds by default, up to 3 minutes with length_sec; hook, twist, cliffhanger; optionally a classic genre such as billionaire, werewolf or mafia), short film (a complete story) or movie trailer from an idea, vertical 9:16 or 16:9, in any of Film Studio's looks (live-action, anime, 3D animation, noir, horror, sci-fi, western, romance, comedy and more). Scenes of up to 30 seconds (one per place and cast), each filmed in one pass with several cuts, on Seedance 2.5, WAN 3 or Kling 4, the cast's faces kept from portraits and every line spoken and lip-synced, cut together with their own sound and one score over the finished edit, with free motion graphics (title card, name tags, end screen; each can be turned off), and saved to the Library. Not for music videos (pixeldojo_music_video) create is free and returns the plan and the exact price (about 190 credits for a regular 30 second film, about 380 for a minute; less on the wan-3-0-video engine and for mature work); produce films it; then call status until it is finished (10-15 minutes).

action.description: create (default, free): writes the plan (30 seconds unless length_sec says, cast, lines) and returns drama_id and the price. Show the plan and price to the user and wait for their OK. produce (charged): films it. status (free): progress; call every ~60s until it returns the episode. redo (charged): re-film chosen beats of a finished episode or one waiting at the review, then it cuts again. cut (free): when the review flagged beats and the user wants it as it is, cut it now.

beats.description: Redo: the beat numbers to film again.

brand_color.description: Create: accent colour for the graphics, #RRGGBB. Default a warm gold.

cast.description: Create (optional): up to 5 characters to star (people, animals or creatures), each with a portrait on the PixelDojo CDN (a saved character from pixeldojo_library; pass its "for video" face and outfit pictures when it lists them). Others get a portrait made for them.

image_url.description: A clear front-facing portrait on the PixelDojo CDN (a saved character's first "for video" picture when it has one).

name.description: The character's name as the story uses it.

outfit_image_url.description: Optional: the saved character's outfit picture (the second "for video" picture from pixeldojo_library). The scenes then keep their clothes closer.

drama_id.description: From create. Required for produce, status and redo.

end_screen.description: Create: a 3.5-second "To be continued" end screen after the last line. Default on.

end_text.description: Create: the end screen's line, up to 60 characters. Default "Episode 2 coming soon".

engine.description: Create (optional): the video model every scene films on, from the cast pictures. seedance-2-5 (default), wan-3-0-video (about a third of the price), kling-4-0. Pass it only when the user names one. Adult work always runs on wan-3-0-video.

idea.description: Create: the story in a line or two (who, the conflict, the twist).

kind.description: Create: micro-drama (default: episode one with a hook and a cliffhanger), short-film (a complete story) or trailer (sells a film that does not exist, never shows the ending).

length_sec.description: Create (optional): the film's length in seconds, 24 to 180 in steps of 6. Default 30. If the user has not said how long, ask (30 seconds, 1, 2 or 3 minutes; the price grows with the length) or leave it out for 30 seconds. The writer splits the length into scenes of up to 30 s, one per place and cast.

logo_url.description: Create: a logo on the PixelDojo CDN for the end screen.

look.description: Create (optional): the visual style and genre. Default live-action (a micro-drama story type brings its own).

mature.description: Create: true for adult work (the server also detects it from the idea). Runs on the less-restricted engines.

name_tags.description: Create: a name and role tag the first time each character speaks. Default on.

notes.description: Redo (optional): what to fix in each of those beats, in the same order.

scenes.description: Create (optional, older): the length in 12-second units (5 = 60 s). Prefer length_sec.

score.description: Create (optional): one score laid over the finished edit, on by default and included in the price. Pass false only when the user wants no music (dialogue and ambience only).

story_type.description: Create (optional, micro-drama only): the genre, which sets its promises (a hidden heir, a fated mate, a debt of blood...). Pick the one the idea fits; omit for anything else.

title_card.description: Create: the episode title over the opening hook. Default on.
